verses.1: And he made Zealel, Oholiab, and all the wise men who God had given wisdom and knowledge, so that they could carry out all the tasks related to the service of the Holy One.
verses.2: And Moses called out to Bezalel, Oholiab, and to all those wise men who God had given wisdom to. All those whose hearts were willing to carry out this task.
verses.3: And they took all the offerings that the Israelites brought, in order to use them for the sacred rituals. They brought more offerings every evening.
verses.4: And all the wise men who perform all the sacred tasks came forward, one by one, to carry out their duties.
verses.5: And they said to Moses, “The people will be too many to carry out the work that Yahweh has commanded us to do.”
verses.6: And Moses commanded, and they spread the word in the camp, saying, “Men and women shall not do any work during this time of preparing for the sacred ceremony.” Thus, the people were ordered not to engage in any work during that time.
verses.7: And the work was difficult for everyone who wanted to do it.
verses.8: And all the wise men did what was necessary in building the house. They used twelve square yards of material, along with nails, ropes, and other tools. They worked carefully to create this house.
verses.9: The length of one of these triangles is fifty cubits, and its width is forty cubits. Each triangle is then divided into two equal parts.
verses.10: And he joined together five of the ribbons together, and five ribbons were joined together with each other.
verses.11: And he made a structure on the edge of one of the lips of the tent. He did the same with the lip of the other tent.
verses.12: Thirty lines were made in one of the corners of the square. Thirty more lines were made at the other corner of the square, which is located next to the second row of lines. These lines are connected to each other.
verses.13: And he made fifty golden columns. He joined the columns together, so that they formed one whole structure.
verses.14: And he made curtains for the altar, on the tabernacle. He made twelve curtains.
verses.15: The length of one side is thirty hours and four hours wide. The total length of one side is twenty-four hours.
verses.16: And he tied together five of the ropes, and six of the ropes separately.
verses.17: And he made fifty looms on the edge of the first vineyard. And he also made fifty looms on the edge of the second vineyard.
verses.18: And Karsai Nechoset made fifty poles to hold up the tent, so that it would be one whole unit.
verses.19: And he made a cover for the altar of burnt offerings, made of earth. And he also made a cover for the altar of incense, made from gold.
verses.20: And he made the frames of the house from wooden planks that stood upright.
verses.21: The length of the cross is twelve amot. The width of one of the crosses is also amah and half of an amah.
verses.22: Two hands were used to join the two pieces together. This is how it was done for all the beams in the structure.
verses.23: And he made the beams for the house. There were forty beams for the upper part of the wall.
verses.24: And he made forty silver bases under the twenty pillars. Two bases were placed under each pillar, one for each hand of the god.
verses.25: And on the wall of the second house, at the entrance to Tzafon, he made forty wooden beams.
verses.26: And forty of their hands were made of silver; two hands under one of the beams, and two hands under the other beam.
verses.27: And when I was building the tent, I made six beams from wood.
verses.28: And he made two beams for the supports of the roof.
verses.29: And they should be equal from top to bottom; together, they should be pure before His face, before that one tabernacle. This is what He did for both of them, for the two extremities.
verses.30: And there were sixteen pillars, with their capitals made of gold. Two capitals were under each pillar.
verses.31: And he made five wooden poles for the pillars of the one bedroom building.
verses.32: And five of them were used for the beams of the second tent. And five of them were also used for the beams of the main tent.
verses.33: And he made the second door to be able to move it within the frames, from one end to the other.
verses.34: And the frames were covered with gold, and their handles were also made of gold. They were polished until they became shiny like gold.
verses.35: And he made the pulley, the crossbar, and the two ropes. He also made six hooks for holding things together. He created these things with great skill.
verses.36: And he made for her four statues of cherubs. He covered them with gold, and he also made four golden handles for them.
verses.37: And he made a structure at the entrance to the temple. There were columns, arches, and other decorations used for covering it.
verses.38: And their handles were five; and their handles and their heads were also made of gold. Their arms were also five in number.
